patch_description: The 5x5 grid layout (sum 1.44) is far worse than the earlier hexagonal lattice approach (sum 2.42). Replace the constructor with the hexagonal multi-row lattice enumeration plus deterministic Gaussian perturbations of the best lattice seeds to broaden the candidate pool, then refine each candidate with repulsion-from-neighbors nudging and Gauss-Seidel radius growth. Layout diversity was the main driver of gains, so cheaply adding perturbed variants (~15 per layout) is high leverage.
